title: Minimum Deletions for a Balanced A-B String
description: A string over `a` and `b` is balanced when it can be written as zero or more `a` characters followed by zero or more `b` characters. Return the minimum number of characters to delete from `s` to make it balanced. Input: a string `s` containing only `a` and `b`. Output: the minimum deletions.
hints: Track only the character counts or prefixes needed to decide the next step.
Check repeated symbols, empty or minimal cases, and impossible arrangements.
